artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan (4.25h) fixing the active_goal dead write: unified Goal-resolution chain across --print and --update-todo, red-then-green regression cases, precedence and conflict-rule documentation, deploy plus full gate set.

memory_candidates.content: scripts/lib/suite-selection-lib.sh's suite_selection_select collapses a MIXED path set to the single __FULL_SWEEP__ sentinel as soon as any one path has no mapped suite -- it does not return the union of per-path answers. A plan phase whose Files to modify mix a suite-covered path (e.g. a .json schema) with an unmapped guidance markdown path therefore must justify its tier with the sentinel's gate-subset form (verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4 <repo_root>), not with the suite list that the covered path returns on its own. validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification honesty check detects the per-path form as a fabricated claim, so the aggregation must be run over the whole set before authoring the line.
